newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes extend rally for domestic grade prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes extend rally for domestic grade prices.

text.p: U.S. outright crudes have returned to the positive side of the price spectrum in a Thursday session dominated by January NYMEX expiration.
Domestic grades have blown out in a dramatic fashion for sweet barrels, and more noticeably in the Jan Postings-Plus at Cushing trade, on short covering refiner plays.
"People buying the P-Plus are basing the price at $1.75 over the Cushing (West Texas Intermediate/Cushing), plus whatever the Jan/Feb WTI spread is on the screen," said a Texas cash dealer.
Jan WTI/Cushing was 35 cts higher at $26.45-55 a barrel.
